colors.note: 12-24: brand hue + tints, accent, greys, status

spacing.note: off-scale values; a dozen deliberate exceptions

typefaces.note: sans for UI, serif accent, mono for code

fontSizes.note: a type scale, up to 10 steps

nearPairs.note: near-identical colours are copy-paste, not decisions

neverImported.note: a system component nobody imports is dead weight

arbitrary.note: bracket escape hatches; a handful of deliberate exceptions

paintTin.note: palette colours in own code where a theme variable exists, per 100 files

themesIncomplete.note: published themes missing a shadcn colour variable in light or dark; a gap here ships into every repo that installs the theme

doorOverrides.note: shadcn components given a colour through className, per 100 files; the tidiest half of 16 shadcn repos sit under this (2026-09-13 audit)

referenceSystems.note: Curated scoped scans of reputable public design systems. Not comparable head-to-head with product repos: see per-system notes.

systems.name: shadcn/ui
systems.note: zero raw values by design; tokens live in one theme file, components use semantic utilities

systems.name: Primer
systems.note: var() fallbacks stopped being counted in 8.0, so the colour count is now the palette itself

systems.name: Polaris
systems.note: tokens live in the separate polaris-tokens package outside this scope

systems.name: Carbon
systems.note: styling lives in separate Sass packages, so colour and radii counts are near zero

systems.name: Material UI
systems.note: colour count is the reference palette shipped as JS; CSS-in-JS theme values are invisible

systems.name: Chakra UI
systems.note: colour count is the token definitions themselves; CSS-in-JS hides spacing and radii

systems.name: Ant Design
systems.note: inline style count is dominated by demos co-located with components

systems.name: GOV.UK Frontend
systems.note: Nunjucks + Sass, so component count is zero by scanner definition; colours are the full government palette

systems.name: Adobe Spectrum
systems.note: styling lives in separate spectrum-css packages; duplicate count is mostly re-export patterns

systems.name: Cloudscape
systems.note: token-driven SCSS keeps colours low; shadow count comes from elevation and motion scss

shadcn.note: every repo in the fleet the scanner reads as shadcn; the "cleaner than" line on a shadcn repo reads against these

tailwind.note: every repo in the fleet the scanner reads as tailwind; the "cleaner than" line on a tailwind repo reads against these

paintTin.note: palette colours in own code where a theme colour exists, per 100 files; 4 of the 11 Tailwind repos sit at or under this, the median is 10 (2026-09-16)

mui.note: every repo in the fleet the scanner reads as mui; the "cleaner than" line on a mui repo reads against these

kitColour.note: colours written onto MUI components per 100 kit files (palettes, charts, editors, theme fallbacks and theme folders not counted; a team layer over MUI counted as MUI); 7 of the 19 MUI products sit at or under this, the median is 9 (2026-09-17)

kitPx.note: padding, margin and gap written in pixels on MUI components per 100 kit files; 6 of 19 sit at or under this, the median is 10 (2026-09-17)

mantine.note: every repo in the fleet the scanner reads as mantine; the "cleaner than" line on a mantine repo reads against these

kitColour.note: colours written onto Mantine components per 100 kit files; 7 of the 19 Mantine products sit at or under this, the median is 3 (2026-09-17)

kitPx.note: spacing written as pixels on Mantine components (p={16}, rem(16)), 10px and up, per 100 kit files; 7 of 19 sit at or under this, the median is 6 (2026-09-17)

chakra.note: every repo in the fleet the scanner reads as chakra; the "cleaner than" line on a chakra repo reads against these

kitColour.note: colours written onto Chakra components per 100 kit files; 6 of the 16 Chakra products sit at or under this, the median is 6 (2026-09-17)

kitPx.note: spacing written as pixel strings on Chakra components (p="12px") per 100 kit files; numbers are space steps and not counted; 7 of 16 sit at or under this, the median is 11 (2026-09-17)

antd.note: every repo in the fleet the scanner reads as antd; the "cleaner than" line on a antd repo reads against these

kitColour.note: colours written onto Ant Design components per 100 kit files; 6 of the 16 Ant Design products sit at or under this, the median is 13 (2026-09-17)

kitPx.note: spacing written as numbers or pixel strings in style objects on Ant Design components (marginBottom: 16), 4px and up, per 100 kit files; 5 of 16 sit at or under this, the median is 22 (2026-09-17)

webcomponents.note: every repo in the fleet the scanner reads as webcomponents; the "cleaner than" line on a webcomponents repo reads against these
